answer_vi: Khi context value object được tạo mới mỗi render, tất cả consumers re-render dù giá trị thực không đổi. Fix: memoize value với useMemo `useMemo(() => ({ user, logout }), [user])`, tách state context và dispatch context riêng, dùng libraries như jotai/zustand tránh context re-render issues. Structural sharing giúp nhưng không đủ.
answer_en: When a context value object is recreated on every render, all consumers re-render even if the actual values have not changed. Fixes: memoize the value with useMemo `useMemo(() => ({ user, logout }), [user])`, split state and dispatch into separate contexts, or use libraries like Jotai or Zustand that avoid context re-render issues altogether. Structural sharing helps but is not sufficient on its own.
